- Brand Introduction:
Beige is a brand that was born out of a passion for health and natural products. We specialise in providing authentic, premium quality supplements with a focus on natural and traditional methods of supporting health. Our flagship product, Beige Mumio (Shijalit), is sourced from pure mountain regions and is carefully selected to guarantee the best possible efficacy.

- Product Description:
Beige Mumio (Shijalit) is a natural mountain resin that has been known for centuries in traditional medicine. It is rich in more than 82 minerals and fulvic acids, which support regeneration, boost immunity and also support the body's natural detoxification processes. Thanks to its unique formula, Mumio acts as a powerful adaptogen, helping the body to cope with stress and supporting the body's overall balance.

- USP (Unique Selling Point):
Top quality: 100% pure Mumio, without additives or preservatives.
Natural origin: Harvested in unspoilt mountain regions according to traditional methods.
Richness of ingredients: More than 82 minerals and fulvic acids that support health on many levels.
Versatility: Supports regeneration, immunity, detoxification and hormonal balance.
Easy to use - simply dissolve in water.
- Payment Terms:
We offer attractive commission terms for our affiliate partners. Payouts are made at regular intervals (e.g. monthly). We work together on a transparent basis, providing our affiliates with support and marketing materials.
Paypal, banktransfer, crypto and more included

- Other Information:
Fast order processing: We are committed to high quality customer service and efficient shipping.
Education and awareness: Beige is committed to educating customers, providing them with reliable information about health and natural supplements.
Visit our website to learn more: https://beige28.pl/products/beige-mumio-shijalit
